description: Baseline synthetic marginals and the dependence-file common-shock share of 0.30. Contract rules are unchanged. Demo assumption, not an official benchmark definition.
Shared-shock weight is zero. Hazard marginal probabilities match the baseline. Demo assumption, not an official benchmark definition.
Shared-shock weight is raised to 0.80 of the smaller marginal. Hazard marginal probabilities match the baseline. Demo assumption, not an official benchmark definition.

Precipitation occurrence probabilities are multiplied by 1.75 and capped at 1. The common-shock share stays at 0.30, so the shared-shock probability (share times the smaller marginal) rises with those marginals. Demo assumption, not an official benchmark definition.

Precipitation cover pays the full precipitation principal for either a moderate or a severe event, still once per term. The baseline pays 50 percent on moderate and 100 percent on severe. Demo assumption, not an official benchmark definition.
